items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: You know like Mangione? He’s still — what is his tune?

ctx.x: Steve Guttman. A trumpet player. Interesting. They sound good. They sound very close to the recordings. That’s what they’re about.
I like that whole scene where an act or a musician can survive playing his old stuff. I like that. You know like Mangione? He’s still — what is his tune?
